summary: A Buncombe County Public Library drop-in LEGO building program held at the Murphy-Oakley Community Center, hosted by the Oakley/South Asheville branch on the first and third Saturday of each month. The library supplies the bricks and explicitly asks attendees to leave personal LEGO sets at home, and the listings use no membership, sign-up, or dues language, just an open invitation to 'families and builders.' It is staff-run programming for a rotating public rather than a persistent group with returning members.

evidence.note: Listing says 'Library: Oakley / South Asheville' and describes library-provided bricks ('we have plenty'), with no mention of members, dues, or a named organizer beyond the library.
Second listing is near-identical boilerplate for the twice-monthly schedule, framed as an open public invitation ('Join us') rather than club membership.

The original listing URLs have since 404'd (events already occurred, page aged off), consistent with these being routine recurring library calendar postings rather than a page for an ongoing named group; no separate website, Facebook group, or Meetup for this club was found.
Same format as sibling library LEGO clubs (e.g. Pack Memorial Library LEGO Builders Club) that other agents independently found to be staff-run drop-in programs, not member groups.
